description.value:
Duration constant

Sound is slower than you are and has been for some time.

Your ranged Strikes ignore all range increments and their penalties out to your weapon's maximum range, and any target that has not yet acted in an encounter is off-guard against your Strikes. A target you hit does not learn your position from the shot itself unless it can otherwise see you.

cinderfall.incomplete: overall — the range-ignoring clause would likely be REAL via AdjustStrike (mode: "override"), same mechanism as long-iron-discipline above, but the "target hasn't acted yet this encounter" off-guard clause has no confirmed roll option to predicate on, and the stealth clause has no selector at all. Flagged as a partial-REAL candidate on the range clause alone, net INCOMPLETE.
